from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer, TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.exceptions import NotFittedError

corpus = [
    'This is the first document.',
    'This is the second second document.',
    'And the third one.',
    'Is this the first document?',
]
vocabulary = ['and', 'document', 'first', 'is', 'one', 'second', 'the', 'third', 'this']

# 1) Provided vocabulary: get_feature_names must work before transform/fit
vec = CountVectorizer(vocabulary=vocabulary)
print("has vocabulary_ before:", hasattr(vec, "vocabulary_"))
print("names:", vec.get_feature_names())
print("has vocabulary_ after:", hasattr(vec, "vocabulary_"))
print("transform ok, shape:", vec.transform(corpus).shape)

# 2) dict / set vocabularies
vec2 = CountVectorizer(vocabulary={t: i for i, t in enumerate(vocabulary)})
print("dict names:", vec2.get_feature_names())
vec3 = CountVectorizer(vocabulary=set(vocabulary))
print("set names:", vec3.get_feature_names())

# 3) No vocabulary: must still raise NotFittedError
vec4 = CountVectorizer()
try:
    vec4.get_feature_names()
    print("ERROR: no exception raised")
except NotFittedError as e:
    print("NotFittedError raised as expected:", e)

# 4) After fitting, TfidfVectorizer and CountVectorizer agree
c = CountVectorizer().fit(corpus)
t = TfidfVectorizer().fit(corpus)
print("fitted names match:", c.get_feature_names() == t.get_feature_names())
print("fitted names:", c.get_feature_names())

# 5) inverse_transform with provided vocabulary works too
inv = vec.inverse_transform(vec.transform(corpus[:1]))[0]
print("inverse_transform:", inv)
